text.20:76: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.
text.35:18: And no burdened soul can bear another's burden, and if one heavy laden crieth for (help with) his load, naught of it will be lifted even though he (unto whom he crieth) be of kin. Thou warnest only those who fear their Lord in secret, and have established worship. He who groweth (in goodness), groweth only for himself, (he cannot by his merit redeem others). Unto Allah is the journeying.
text.79:18: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
text.80:3: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
text.80:7: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
text.92:18: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
